description: This file defines the WorkbookView class responsible for parsing and applying view settings from an XLSX workbook view XML element. It interacts with a Spreadsheet object to configure properties like scrollbars, sheet tabs, active sheet, visibility, and layout attributes based on XML attributes.

classes.name: WorkbookView
classes.description: Handles the application of workbook view settings from XML to a Spreadsheet object, including scrollbars, sheet tabs, active sheet, visibility, minimized state, and layout attributes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the WorkbookView with a Spreadsheet object.

methods.name: viewSettings
methods.description: Reads view settings from an XML element and applies them to the Spreadsheet, including active sheet, scroll positions, tab visibility, and other view-related attributes.

methods.name: testSimpleXml
methods.description: Ensures the provided value is a SimpleXMLElement, wrapping it in a default root element if not.

methods.name: getAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves attributes from a SimpleXMLElement, returning an empty element if the input is null.

methods.name: castXsdBooleanToBool
methods.description: Converts an 'xsd:boolean' string to a PHP boolean, handling string values 'true', 'false', '1', '0'.

methods.name: horizontalScroll
methods.description: Sets the horizontal scrollbar visibility based on XML attributes.

methods.name: verticalScroll
methods.description: Sets the vertical scrollbar visibility based on XML attributes.

methods.name: sheetTabs
methods.description: Sets the visibility of sheet tabs.

methods.name: minimized
methods.description: Sets whether the workbook view is minimized.

methods.name: autoFilterDateGrouping
methods.description: Configures the auto filter date grouping setting.

methods.name: firstSheet
methods.description: Sets the index of the first sheet displayed.

methods.name: visibility
methods.description: Sets the visibility state of the workbook view.

methods.name: tabRatio
methods.description: Configures the ratio of tab display.
